description: The inputs group ('YOUR LEVERS') for the payoff calculator: a strategy segmented picker, an extra-monthly-payment input with preset chips, and a selectable debt list. Flat glass (subordinate to the floating headline). Every change re-derives the headline live.

strategySegment.layout: 3 equal segments, gap spacing.sm, radius.md, minHeight 56 (>=44 target)
strategySegment.active: fill colors.primary; label typography.smallBold colors.text; desc typography.caption colors.text@85; checkmark glyph
strategySegment.inactive: glassEffects.glass fill; label colors.textMuted; desc colors.textDark

extraPaymentInput.input: typography.h2 colors.primary2, centered, '$' affix colors.textMuted, keyboardType numeric, placeholder '$0' colors.textMuted, clamp >=0

presetChip.layout: wrap row, gap spacing.sm, radius.full, padding spacing.sm x spacing.md, >=44 target (hit-slop)
presetChip.selected: fill colors.primary, text typography.smallBold colors.text, checkmark glyph

debtRow.layout: full-width tappable >=44, gap spacing.md, radius.md, border colors.borderGlass
debtRow.name: typography.smallBold, selected colors.text / unselected colors.textMuted, numberOfLines 1
debtRow.header: label 'Debts included' typography.smallBold + '{selected} of {total}' caption + All/None text button colors.primary2 >=44
debtRow.zeroSelectedWarning: alert-circle-outline colors.warning + 'Select at least one debt to calculate.'

accessibility.strategy: radiogroup; each radio selected state; announces '{label} selected, {desc} first.'
accessibility.debtRow: role checkbox, checked state, label '{name}, {balance}, {apr} percent APR{, included}.', hint 'Double tap to include or exclude from payoff.'
accessibility.colorIndependence: all selected states use fill + checkmark/checkbox glyph, not color alone
accessibility.contrast: unselected debt names use colors.textMuted at full opacity (not colors.text dimmed) to clear 4.5:1

reuse: Skeleton (loading: 3 segment blocks + input block + 3 chips + 3 rows)
notes: Recompute chain unchanged: strategy/extraPayment/selectedIds feed the existing useMemo(computePayoff, [focusedDebts, extraPayment, strategy]). Typing a custom amount naturally deselects all preset chips (none match).
